title: Feature browser: a bordered panel with the feature id and name, monospace token strips highlighted in three oranges by activation, a ranked top-activations list with bars, an activation ramp legend and a numbered caption
use: One feature in a paper's browser: dataset examples with their activating tokens and the ranked list of strongest activations; seed moves the peaks and rows (3-5) sets how many examples.

ex_{i}.note: dataset example i: tokens separated by spaces, one tspan per token

val_{i}.note: activation of rank i, from the seed

caption.default: 特征 #2417 的数据集示例与最强激活词。示例数据：激活值由种子生成，不来自真实模型。

relations: Panel 1408 x 650 units at (96, 96), radius 5; header 26-unit bold id and 22-unit name above a hairline; strips are 880 x 62 units in the beige with a stone outline, mono 24 units; a token highlight is a rect inset 7 units behind the token in hot_lo (below 0.66 of the peak), hot_mid or hot_hi, with black text.
The top-activations list sits right of the strips: mono 20-unit token, a bar on a beige track and the derived value (two decimals) at the right edge; ranks fall by about 0.11.
decoration: Strip frames, highlights, bars and tracks are decoration for the text checks (the highlight is the text's ground and black text is 8:1 on every orange); tokens, values and labels are slots.

provenance.corpus: research-paper kit (examples/circuits-paper-kit): our own original interactive paper page in the circuits-paper grammar; all copy, features and numbers are labelled samples
provenance.experiment: styles/circuits-paper/style.json provenance (three public reference pages measured privately in Chrome on 2026-11-21; never shipped)
provenance.method: The reference attribution paper's feature visualisation (monospace tokens, orange highlights by activation) lifted into a panel with a ranked list.
